newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CNP/NPM 1996 group net profit soars.
newsitem.headline: CNP/NPM 1996 group net profit soars.

text.p: (in billions of Belgian francs unless stated)

NOTE - Compagnie Nationale a Portefeuille/Nationale Portefeuillemaatschappij (CNP) is an investment vehicle of Belgian financier Albert Frere, which in turn controls Swiss-based Pargesa Holding and Belgium's Groupe Bruxelles Lambert (GBL). It had released partial data in February. It said it was planning to hold on to its current dividend policy.

CNP said that the estimated net asset value per share was 2,740 francs on December 31, 1996 (after dividend payout), against 2,393 francs a year earlier. It said its April 16 share price of 2,365 francs showed a 24.5 percent discount compared with the estimated value per share of about 3,130 francs.
